title: He crossed to the bright side, avoiding the loose cellarflap of number seventyfive
html_source: An uncharacteristic error of Joyce; number seventy five wasn’t quite opposite number 7 Eccles Street, apparently Joyce based it on Thom’s 1904 (Gifford).

anchor.text: He crossed to the bright side, avoiding the loose cellarflap of number seventyfive
anchor.prefix: t time. He pulled the halldoor to after him very quietly, more, till the footleaf dropped gently over the threshold, a limp lid. Looked shut. All right till I come back anyhow.
anchor.suffix: . The sun was nearing the steeple of George's church. Be a warm day I fancy. Specially in these black clothes feel it more. Black conducts, reflects, (refracts is it?), the heat. B
